desc:
Aerial view of Chelmer and Fig Tree Pocket, 1941.
Aerial view of the Brisbane suburbs of Chelmer and Fig Tree Pocket. Chelmer Streets include Laurel Avenue, Verney Road West, Mortlake Road, Kew Road and a small section of Richmond Street as well as the house known as Rakeevan.
